_comment: Register relay-v2 as an MCP server for Claude Code / Claude Desktop. Copy the 'relay-v2' entry into your project's .mcp.json (Claude Code) or claude_desktop_config.json mcpServers block. The relay-v2 backend must be running (relay serve; default 127.0.0.1:7800). The URL host:port must stay on 127.0.0.1/localhost — the MCP server enforces a localhost DNS-rebinding allow-list (ADR-12 single-user, ADR-27).
